content_classification: Public action bytes, current HGPSLC02 carriers and SMZL proof bytes; no witness or prover scratch file.

Pinned source inventories contain paths, byte lengths and hashes; receipt contains ephemeral local path/PID/localhost RPC metadata, public addresses/commitments/nullifiers, and declared executable identities.
Recovery log contains empty hidden passphrase prompts and a public bootstrap identity, not wallet/key/account backup bytes.

Reward authorization_key_hex and related note opening fields are exact public coinbase payload fields (protocol/shielded-pool/src/poseidon2_v8_coinbase.rs and node/src/native/rpc.rs), not exported spending credentials.
limitations: This review inspected only the exported public directory and frozen public source/config. It did not open the raw run, disposable fixture/passphrase, wallet, key/seed backup, database, witness, or prover scratch.

The coordinator reports checking the actual disposable passphrase bytes against all 82 files. That exact-secret comparison is attributed to the coordinator; this reviewer independently performed bounded content, schema, field, argv, prompt, text-shape and framing checks without access to the secret.

No tests, native executable, proof generation/cryptographic verification, network operation, build, process control or Git mutation was performed by this reviewer. Pure runtime_gates consumed only retained public evidence; runtime_evidence was not invoked because it may read external executables.
Executable SHA256 values and process/RPC outcomes are retained receipt observations, not independently executed artifact/proof/closure results by this reviewer.

The funded process evidence is Development H120 on one host/clock, not a production H18660 execution, sustained throughput measurement, independent refund custody demonstration, or physical ASIC qualification.

Qualification commands are still empty and independent_review is null at this review snapshot. A separate actual final software-scope review after command installation, exact-head CI, ordinary per-target actual proof/H0 checks, and six focused suites remain required. This review confers no release, activation, mainnet or deployment authority.
Finite inspection and pattern checks do not prove universal absence of every possible sensitive value; no publication blocker was found in the exact pinned bytes reviewed.

reviewer.method: Independent read-only inspection and pure byte/JSON/framing checks; no delegated review or native execution.
reviewer.name: Codex independent review agent

scope: Publication suitability of the exact exported actual10 public evidence bundle for requested public GitHub source evidence. This is not final software-candidate acceptance or final artifact qualification.
